summary: Parke Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: PKBK) filed an 8-K on September 22, 2026, announcing that its board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.20 per share, payable October 16, 2026, to stockholders of record as of the close of business on October 2, 2026. The company stated it anticipates paying cash dividends quarterly, subject to board determination and regulatory restrictions, and noted dividends may be reduced or eliminated. No advisor or board recommendation beyond declaration was disclosed. The ex-dividend date falls near the record date, so watch for standard price adjustment and any shift in forward payout guidance given the explicit caveat.
